Accounting and Finance
01

Accounting and Finance
(Subscription-Based Pricing) (Fixed)
●
Involves recurring (monthly or annual fees) that grant users general access to an AI platform 
and its basic functionalities
●
Provides limited usage within a speciﬁed tier
●
Models with more capabilities are priced higher
(Token-Based Pricing) (Variable)
●
Involves charging users based on the number of tokens (units of data) processed
●
The amount of tokens used correspond to the complexity of the task being performed
●
Allows for more personalized usage based on user interactions

Accounting and Finance Continued
(Hybrid Approach) 
●
Combines the predictability of subscription 
pricing with ﬂexibility of usage-based 
pricing 
●
Involves ﬁxed and variable components
●
Allows users to scale their AI

Operational Eﬃciency
02

Operational Eﬃciency 
Accuracy: 
ChatGPT: Generates rapidly yet tends to repeat 
information; Most accurate knowledge on many 
tasks 
Microsoft CoPilot: Answers are not always accurate 
or high quality; but quick responses 
Gemini: Designed for quick replies and information grabs; So new 
it is still unreliable, many are not happy with the quality either 
Claude: Quick and never repetitive; While pretty accuracy, some 
have found it can sometimes hallucinate 
Response Times:
ChatGPT: 194.1 tokens per second
CoPilot: Could not locate
Gemini: 245.2 tokens per seconds
Claude: 75.9 tokens per seconds

Operational Eﬃciency → Teaching Impact  
ChatGPT: 
AI tutor, assignment helper, discussion generator
Microsoft CoPilot: 
Lecture slide building, feedback on student writing, 
quick rubric creation
Gemini: 
Real-time collaborative lesson building, 
prompt-driven content generation 
Claude: 
Reﬂection prompts, discussion starter, outline 
generator.
“Many faculty are already incorporating AI into their curriculum and teaching strategies. By using generative 
AI…faculty can focus on more value-added aspects of the learning experience” - RIT

Operational Eﬃciency → Research Impact  
ChatGPT: 
Finds and summarizes articles, coding assistant, 
speeds up the process
Microsoft CoPilot: 
Analyzes data, creates visualizations in Excel, helps 
with complex computation, boosts productivity
Gemini: 
Translates and brainstorms, assists with multilingual 
research, quick searches
Claude: 
Privacy focused, suitable for handling data, suitable 
for conﬁdential research
“Many faculty are currently working with generative AI in their classrooms or research…invited proposals for 
incorporating generative AI as [a] tool…” - RIT

Operational Eﬃciency → Operations Impact 
ChatGPT: 
Helps with FQA’s, can help automate campus 
servers, improve accessibility and efﬁciency with 
student support 
Microsoft CoPilot: 
Summarize emails, schedule assistant, streamline 
administrative tasks, already integrated into Dell
Gemini: 
Smart replies, integrates easily into Google 
applications, can streamline workﬂow
Claude: 
Analyze policies, draft important documents, help 
make informed decision schoolwide
“The AI Task Force…formed to help the university examine important questions and arrive at recommendations 
for shared solutions, best practices, and ethical approaches [to] carry forward” - RIT

Operational Eﬃciency → Best Uses
ChatGPT: 
Best for creative writing, brainstorming, 
educational support, and general-purpose Q&A 
tasks 
Microsoft CoPilot: 
Ideal for professionals using Microsoft 365 or 
GitHub, focusing on productivity and workﬂow 
efﬁciency
Claude: 
Suited for ethical AI needs, research-driven 
communication, and sensitive content creation 
requiring clear and coherent outputs
Gemini: 
Perfect for data-driven tasks, collaborative 
workﬂows, and projects requiring multi-modal 
inputs like combining text and images

Marketing Logistics
03

Marketing (ChatGPT)
Current Marketing Message: Interacts with their target market a conversational way, focusing on 
marketing through digital channels and content marketing, and have leveraged the brand 
recognition from OpenAI (it’s parent company) to make it more successful.
Framing The Marketing Message: Emphasize the current massive usage across the world, meaning 
it is getting constantly fed new information, while also having the ability to be trained to answer 
prompts in context based scenarios based on previously fed information.

Recommendations
05

Our Pick (Gemini) 
●
Our data analysis indicates that Gemini 2.0 is the overall best choice for 
University Implementation
●
With further development, Gemini 2.0 will only become better and more 
effective 
●
Its cost-cost effective nature, operational efﬁciency, and wide span of 
functions make it the most ideal for implementation at RIT
(Conclusion)
●
Ultimate Selection should consider the suitability of said model for RIT 
students/their needs, accuracy of data being processed and generated, the 
possibility of error in data analysis, privacy of data acquired, and timeliness 
of said model and its developments

Thank You
We hope you found this presentation insightful
